_about: Every string a player reads, written before the build against TONE.md. Implement each string exactly as written. Values in braces are placeholders that the page fills from core or from data; _placeholders says where each comes from. Keys that begin with an underscore are instructions and are never shown to a player.

_placeholders.hash: the build hash stamped by packaging/package-web.sh
the current binding for that action, from data/controls.json or the player's saved bindings
_placeholders.left_keys, right_keys: the bound keys for that seat, joined in binding order
_placeholders.opponent: opponents.<id>.name, for the start of a sentence or a heading
_placeholders.opponent_mid: opponents.<id>.name_mid, for the middle of a sentence
_placeholders.part: parts.<id>, for the part the deciding cut crossed, as reported by core
_placeholders.delay_ms: the match's input delay in ticks, converted to milliseconds by core
_placeholders.tick: the first tick whose checksums differed, from the lockstep
_placeholders.pause_s, reach_pct, horizon_ms, reaction: derived from that opponent's entry in data/pilots.json; never typed
_placeholders.theirs, ours: the version in the file and the version this build reads

game.name: Vagrancy
game.description: A physics sword-fighting game for two players, in which you move your fighter's arms one joint at a time.
game.content_note: The fighters are paper figures. A cut removes part of a figure and spills ink, which stands in for blood.
game.loading_error: The game could not load. Reload the page and try again.
game.fallback: This game requires JavaScript and WebAssembly.

road.label: Walk the road
road.desc: Fight the opponents on the road in order, from the easiest to the hardest.

local.label: Play at one keyboard
local.desc: Two players share this keyboard and fight each other.

online.label: Play a friend online
online.desc: One of you hosts a match and the other joins it.

practice.label: Practice in the yard
practice.desc: Swing at a post that does not fight back. This is the place to learn the keys.

replay.label: Load a replay
replay.desc: Open a replay file and watch that match again.

control.title: What you control
control.body: You control your fighter's sword arm. {key.shoulder_up} raises the arm at the shoulder and {key.shoulder_down} lowers it. {key.elbow_in} bends the elbow and {key.elbow_out} straightens it. A joint keeps turning for as long as you hold its key, so a swing is a matter of when you press and when you let go.
control.legs: The legs keep your fighter upright without your help. {key.step_left} and {key.step_right} take a slow step. Faster movement comes from the sword.

sword.title: The sword is solid
sword.body: The sword does not bend, and it does not pass through the ground or through another sword. That makes it useful for more than cutting. If you plant the tip in the ground and straighten your arm, the sword pushes your fighter into the air.

swing.title: A swing adds speed
swing.body: Swinging the sword pulls your whole fighter along with it. In this game that pull is free: a swing adds speed without taking it from anywhere else. Keep swinging in the same direction and your fighter moves faster, up to a limit.

cut.title: What a blade does
cut.body: When a blade touches a fighter, it cuts straight across the part it touched, and the part beyond the cut drops off. Your own blade does this to your own fighter too. The hands holding the sword are the exception.

ink.title: Ink
ink.body: The fighters are paper figures filled with ink. A cut that does not end the round spills ink for the rest of the round, and a larger cut spills it faster. The meter above a fighter shows how much ink that fighter has left.

end.title: How a round ends
end.body: A round ends when a fighter cannot continue. That happens when a cut crosses the neck or the head, when a cut crosses the heart, or when a fighter runs out of ink.

match.title: How a match ends
match.body: The first fighter to win {rounds_to_win} rounds wins the match. Between rounds both fighters are restored.

files.title: Replays and save files
files.body: You can download a match as a replay. Loading that file plays the same match again, input for input. You can download your progress on the road as a save file in Settings.

practice.intro: The post does not fight back, so you can take as long as you need. The steps below go in order, and you can repeat any of them.

step.shoulder: Start with the shoulder. Hold {key.shoulder_up} and watch the arm rise, then let go. The sword is heavy, so the arm keeps moving for a moment after you release the key.
step.elbow: Now the elbow. Hold {key.elbow_out} to straighten the arm and {key.elbow_in} to bend it. A straight arm reaches farther.
step.cut: Cut the post. A blade cuts the part it touches, so a swing that reaches the post is enough. Look at where the cut lands: it is at the point the blade touched.
step.plant: Plant the sword. Point the tip at the ground, then straighten your arm. The sword cannot go into the ground, so the push lifts your fighter instead.
step.swing: Build speed. Swing in one direction several times without stopping. A swing adds to the one before it, which is how you cross the yard quickly or leave the ground.
step.move: Move. Hold {key.step_left} or {key.step_right} and the ground carries your fighter that way. The legs stay straight and keep your fighter upright, so your attention can stay on the sword.
step.jump: Jump. Press {key.jump} to leave the ground. You can press it once more while you are in the air, and you get that second jump back when you land.
step.air_jump: Push off the air. Your second jump works as if your fighter bounced off a wall you cannot see: hold {key.step_left} or {key.step_right} as you press {key.jump} to push off toward that side, or neither to push straight up. A fall turns into a rise at the same speed, so a jump late in a fall goes higher than one at the top.
step.stand: Get up. If your fighter is knocked off its feet but still has both legs, press {key.stand} to stand back up where you are.
step.dodge: Dodge. Press {key.dodge} and for a moment no blade can cut your fighter, so you can let an attack pass through you. Your own blade cuts nothing during that moment either.
step.roll: Roll. Hold {key.step_left} or {key.step_right} as you press {key.dodge} and your fighter rolls that way along the ground. With neither held, your fighter dodges in place.
step.air_dodge: Dodge in the air. Press {key.dodge} while you are off the ground and your fighter is carried sideways in the direction you hold. It uses up your jump in the air, so save it for when you need to get out of the way.
step.cooldown: After a dodge there is a short wait before you can dodge again, so a dodge is a choice and not something to press over and over.
step.block: Block. Swords are solid, so a blade that meets yours stops. Holding your sword in front of you is a way to stop a swing before it reaches you.
step.ink: Watch the ink. A cut that does not end the round leaves a stump that spills ink until the round ends. The meters at the top show how much ink each fighter has left.

practice.review: new: practice.step.move, jump, air_jump, stand, dodge, roll, air_dodge, cooldown, block, ink, and hud.keys
practice.done: Those are the controls. The road teaches the rest, one opponent at a time.

hud.keys: Your keys: {key.shoulder_up} and {key.shoulder_down} turn the shoulder, {key.elbow_in} and {key.elbow_out} bend and straighten the elbow, {key.step_left} and {key.step_right} move, {key.jump} jumps, {key.dodge} dodges and {key.stand} stands you up.

left.described: Indigo, the solid figure on the left

road.win_neck: You won the round. Your blade cut across {opponent_mid}'s {part}.
road.win_heart: You won the round. Your blade cut across {opponent_mid}'s heart.
road.win_ink: You won the round. {opponent} ran out of ink.
road.win_self: You won the round. {opponent}'s own blade made the cut that ended it.
road.lose_neck: You lost the round. {opponent}'s blade cut across your {part}.
road.lose_heart: You lost the round. {opponent}'s blade cut across your heart.
road.lose_ink: You lost the round. You ran out of ink, and the cut to your {part} spilled the most.
road.lose_self: You lost the round. Your own blade cut across your {part}.
road.match_win: You won the match, {wins} rounds to {losses}.
road.match_lose: You lost the match, {losses} rounds to {wins}. {opponent} is still on the road when you want to try again.

versus.neck: {winner} won the round. {winner}'s blade cut across {loser}'s {part}.
versus.heart: {winner} won the round. {winner}'s blade cut across {loser}'s heart.

results.key_hint: Press {key} to choose the first button, so you can go on without the mouse.

road.intro: You are walking a road with a sword you are still learning to use. The people who stop you fight in different ways. Before a fight you are told what that opponent does and one thing you could try. The suggestion is a starting point, and there are other answers.
road.locked: You reach this stop after you win at the one before it.
road.cleared: You have won here. You can fight {opponent_mid} again.
road.end: That was the last opponent on the road. You can fight any of them again from this screen. If you found an approach that the suggestions did not mention, the suggestions were incomplete.

scarecrow.name: The Scarecrow
scarecrow.place: A rice field outside the first village.
scarecrow.does: The scarecrow does not move and does not fight back. It is here so that your first cut costs you nothing.
scarecrow.try: Cut it anywhere, to see how a cut works. Then aim for the neck, because a cut there ends the round.

gatekeeper.name: The Gatekeeper
gatekeeper.place: A toll gate. Someone has pasted concert posters over the list of tolls.
gatekeeper.does: The gatekeeper holds his sword out in front of him and keeps it there. He does not swing. Swords are solid, so yours stops when it meets his.
gatekeeper.try: Go over his blade or under it, not through it. Look for the part of him that the sword is not in front of.

thresher.name: The Thresher
thresher.place: A threshing floor behind a farmhouse.
thresher.does: The thresher makes the same overhead swing again and again, with the same pause after each swing. The pause lasts about {pause_s} seconds.
thresher.try: Stay out of reach and count the pause. Then move in after a swing has passed, while the blade is still low.

ferryman.name: The Ferryman
ferryman.place: A ferry landing. A radio on the far bank is playing a drum loop.
ferryman.does: The ferryman's blade is about {reach_pct} percent longer than yours. A longer blade reaches you first when you both swing level. It is also heavier, so it takes him longer to start a swing and to stop one.
ferryman.try: Let him swing first. While his blade is still traveling, you have time that he does not.

vaulter.name: The Vaulter
vaulter.place: A dry riverbed with a hard clay floor.
vaulter.does: The vaulter plants her sword, lifts herself over you, and cuts downward as she passes. Her attacks usually come from above.
vaulter.try: Watch where her sword is planted. While the tip is in the ground it is not pointed at you, and she has committed to a path.

windmill.name: The Windmill
windmill.place: A crossroads on a hill, in a steady wind.
windmill.does: The windmill does not stop swinging. He builds speed the way you can, by swinging in one direction, and then drifts toward you with the blade turning.
windmill.try: Meet his blade with yours. Swords are solid, so a firm block stops the turn, and he needs time to build the speed again.

sampler.name: The Sampler
sampler.place: A tea house with a turntable on the counter.
sampler.does: The sampler has no style of her own. She watches the first round without attacking. From then on she repeats what you did in the previous round, mirrored.
sampler.try: What you do in this round is what you face in the next. Choose something you know how to answer.

reader.name: The Reader
reader.place: The end of the road, at a gate that is already open.
reader.does: The reader tries several moves a short way ahead before she chooses. She looks about {horizon_ms} milliseconds into the future, and she acts on what she saw {reaction_ms} milliseconds ago.
reader.try: She does not check further ahead than that. A move that looks harmless at first and changes late is one she has not seen coming.

drover.name: The Drover
drover.place: A cattle track between two stone walls.
drover.does: The drover walks straight at you and swings low, at your legs, as soon as you are in reach. He does not guard.
drover.try: Meet him above the sweep. A jump or a high cut lands while his blade is still low.

lamplighter.name: The Lamplighter
lamplighter.place: A street of iron lamps that are lit at noon.
lamplighter.does: The lamplighter keeps her sword high and waits. When you come close she thrusts, and if you come closer still she steps back.
lamplighter.try: Draw the thrust, step out of its way, and come in under the high blade while her arm is still out.

cooper.name: The Cooper
cooper.place: A yard full of barrels, with a bicycle leaning on one of them.
cooper.does: The cooper jumps at you and cuts as he comes down. If he lands badly, he gets up again before he does anything else.
cooper.try: Step aside as he leaves the ground, and cut as he lands.

bellringer.name: The Bellringer
bellringer.place: A bell tower whose bell has been replaced by a loudspeaker.
bellringer.does: The bellringer spins his sword and walks into you with it turning. When your point comes near his head, he dodges away and starts again.
bellringer.try: A dodge leaves him a moment with a still blade. Strike as he comes back in, not while the sword is turning.

courier.name: The Courier
courier.place: A relay station with a pile of parcels and a pager on a nail.
courier.does: The courier keeps her distance and backs away when you come close. Now and then she rolls straight through your guard and cuts as she comes out of the roll.
courier.try: Her roll ends close to you. Keep your blade where she will be standing when it ends.

ropewalker.name: The Ropewalker
ropewalker.place: A rope strung between two poles over a dry ditch.
ropewalker.does: The ropewalker fights from the air. She jumps, pushes off the air toward you, and cuts downward as she falls.
ropewalker.try: Hold your sword above you as she comes down, because a blade that meets yours stops.

salt_trader.name: The Salt Trader
salt_trader.place: A salt warehouse with a cash register on a crate.
salt_trader.does: The salt trader waits behind a high guard. When your point comes near her body she dodges through you and cuts, and when you dodge she cuts where you are.
salt_trader.try: She answers your attacks rather than starting her own. Bring your point close to draw her dodge, then strike as it ends.

smith.name: The Smith
smith.place: A forge whose bellows run on an electric motor.
smith.does: The smith plants his sword and vaults over you, or jumps and pushes off the air to cut down at you. When your point comes at his head he dodges, and when he is knocked down he stands up at once.
smith.try: He spends a lot of his time in the air. Cut at him as he lands, when his second jump is used up.

archivist.name: The Archivist
archivist.place: A record office where the shelves hold vinyl next to the ledgers.
archivist.does: The archivist tries several moves a short way ahead before she chooses, and she dodges most attacks that come at her head. She reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after she sees your blade move.
archivist.try: Attack her legs and body rather than her head, because those are the cuts she does not dodge.

watchman.name: The Watchman
watchman.place: A gatehouse at the end of a bridge, with a television left on inside.
watchman.does: The watchman dodges attacks at his head, cuts at you when you leave the ground, jumps and pushes off the air, and stands up at once when knocked down. Between those he tries moves a short way ahead. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
watchman.try: He punishes a jump. Stay on the ground, keep your guard up, and make him come to you.

local.intro: Two players share this keyboard. {left_name} is on the left and uses {left_keys}. {right_name} is on the right and uses {right_keys}.
local.keyboard_limit: Some keyboards stop registering new keys when several are held at once. If an arm stops responding while both of you are pressing keys, that is the likely cause. Changing the key bindings in Settings sometimes helps.

online.intro: One of you hosts and the other joins. The match then runs directly between your two browsers.
online.privacy: A direct connection means your friend's browser learns your IP address, and yours learns theirs. Play online with people you are willing to share that with.
online.music: Music is not shared. You hear the track you loaded, and your friend hears theirs.

host_room.label: Host with a room code
host_room.desc: You get a short code and a link to send to your friend. Public relay servers, which this project does not run, introduce your two browsers. After that the match does not use them.

join_room.label: Join with a room code
join_room.desc: Open the link your friend sent, or type their room code here.

host_paste.label: Host with a pasted code
host_paste.desc: Use this if a room code does not connect. You send your friend a block of text, they send one back, and no relay is involved.
host_paste.step_copy: Copy this invitation and send it to your friend in a chat you already use.

join_paste.label: Join with a pasted code
join_paste.step_paste: Paste the invitation your friend sent you.
join_paste.step_reply: Copy this reply and send it back to your friend.

copy.label: Copy to clipboard
copy.done: The text is on your clipboard.
copy.failed: Your browser did not allow copying. Select the text and copy it yourself.

online.waiting: Waiting for your friend to join. The room code is {code}.
online.joining: Looking for the match with room code {code}.

connected.host: Your friend has joined. Input delay for this match is {delay_ms} milliseconds, chosen from how long a message takes to travel between you and back.
connected.join: You have joined. Input delay for this match is {delay_ms} milliseconds, chosen from how long a message takes to travel between you and back. The host starts the match.

error.no_relay: No relay answered, so your two browsers could not be introduced. Try hosting with a pasted code, which does not need a relay.
error.no_path: Your two browsers found each other but could not open a direct connection. This usually means one of you is on a network that blocks direct connections, and a pasted code would fail the same way. Trying from a different network is the next step.
error.build: You and your friend are running different builds of the game. Both of you should reload the page and then try again.
error.full: This match already has two players.
error.bad_code: That code could not be read. Check that the whole block of text was copied, from its first character to its last.

status.waiting_on: Waiting for your friend's input. If this continues, one of the two connections is slow.
status.left: Your friend's browser stopped responding, so the match has ended.
status.desync: The two copies of the match disagreed at tick {tick}. The match has stopped so that it does not continue as two different fights. You can download the replay to report it.

ready.label: Tell your friend you are ready
ready.you: You are ready, and your friend has been told.
ready.friend_not: Your friend has not said they are ready yet.
ready.again: Tell your friend you want another match

music.title: Music
music.desc: The game does not include a music track. You can load one from this device, and it loops during fights.

load.label: Load a track from this device

music.privacy: The file is read by your browser and is not uploaded. In an online match your friend does not hear it.

remember.label: Remember this track on this device
remember.desc: This keeps a copy of the file in this browser's storage for this site. Clearing the site's data removes it.

music.error: This file could not be played. Your browser reported: {error}
music.formats: MP3, Ogg and WAV files play in most browsers.

youtube.title: Music from YouTube
youtube.desc: A video is already chosen. Press Play the video and it plays on a loop in a small player in the corner of the page. To play a different one, paste its link here first.
youtube.error: That is not a link to a YouTube video. Copy the address from the video's page and paste it here.
youtube.privacy: Nothing is sent to YouTube until you start the video. After that, YouTube sees that this page is playing the video, as it does for any embedded video. In an online match your friend does not hear it.

keys.title: Key bindings
keys.desc: Choose a key for each action. Two actions cannot share a key.
keys.conflict: {key} is already used for {action}. Choose a different key, or change that binding first.

solo.heading: Keys for the road, the practice yard and online matches

actions.shoulder_up: Raise the arm at the shoulder
actions.shoulder_down: Lower the arm at the shoulder

motion.label: Reduce motion
motion.desc: Turns off screen shake and slow motion.

save.title: Save file

download.label: Download save file
download.desc: This writes your progress on the road and your settings to a file that you keep.

save.autosave: The game also keeps a copy in this browser so that you can continue after a reload. That copy is a convenience. Clearing the site's data removes it, so download a save file if you want to keep your progress.

error.format: This file is not a {game} save file, so nothing was loaded.
error.newer: This save file was written by a newer version of the game. It is save version {theirs}, and this build reads up to version {ours}. Nothing was loaded.
error.damaged: This save file is incomplete or damaged, so nothing was loaded. Your current progress is unchanged.

replay.playing: You are watching a replay. Pressing keys does not change it.

error.format: This file is not a {game} replay, so nothing was loaded.
error.sim: This replay was recorded with simulation version {theirs}, and this build runs version {ours}. The same inputs would not produce the same match, so the replay was not loaded.
error.damaged: This replay file is incomplete or damaged, so nothing was loaded.
